J1.evidence: Verse 3563 «وذَاتَ اللِّثاثِ الجُمِّ والفاحِمِ الجَعْدِ»: اللِّثاث is plural of لِثَة (gums), الجُمّ = plentiful; TR «bol saçlı» (abundant hair) is wrong meaning (should be 'dolgun/bol diş etli'); EN 'abundant gums' is right. Also unmarked additions in TR: «Ben (Semîn) dedim» for «قلت» and «[Bu «وجدتُ»]» not inside Mütercim notu; and «للتحضيضِ» rendered «tahdîd» (threat) instead of tahdîz/tahzîz.

J2.evidence: Verse 3563 «وذَاتَ اللِّثاثِ الجُمِّ والفاحِمِ الجَعْدِ»: اللِّثاث is the plural of لِثَة (gums), الجُمّ = abundant; only «الفاحِم الجَعْد» refers to hair. TR 'bol saçlı, kapkara kıvırcık saçlı' turns اللثاث into hair (hair twice) - wrong meaning (EN 'abundant gums' follows the Arabic). Fix: 'dolgun diş etli'. (Minor: TR 'tahdîd (teşvik)' for «للتحضيض» should read 'tahdîd' -> 'tahdîz'; rest of the long entry checked and faithful.)
